meta.summary: Hides "better on the app" pop-up, Open Snapchat bars, home page download promo, Comment button, like, share and view counts
meta.notes: LIVE (headless Chromium, iPhone 390x844 UA, logged out, 2026-11-08). www.snapchat.com/: [data-testid=mobile-nav] a[class*=downloadButton]=1 (Open Snapchat), a[data-testid=home-install-link]=1, a[data-testid=home-hero-download]=1, [data-testid=home-mobile] div[class*=mobileSlides]=1, section[aria-labelledby=home-mobile-closing-heading]=1, [data-testid=home-explore]=1, [data-testid=mobile-tab-bar]=1, [data-testid=global-footer]=1 (footer links, aria-hidden content collapsed). Still the same after 30 s; no cookie banner, no role=dialog, mobile-cta-bottom-sheet is an empty aria-hidden placeholder, so no rule targets it. /spotlight redirects to a video at /@<user>/spotlight/<id> (scaffold, player, engagement rail): [data-testid=spotlight-engagement-rail] button:nth-of-type(3)=2 (Comment; slides active+next are rendered), span[class*=__count]=7 (Like/Recommend/Share numbers), top-bar Open Snapchat=1, tab bar=1. Public profile /@<user> (/add/<user> redirects there): [data-testid=mobileExpandedCtaBanner]=1 and -backdrop=1 (fixed, 'Snapchat is better on the app' sheet with Open in Snapchat / Continue), [data-testid=mobileCTAHeader]=1, [data-testid=mobile-nav-bottom]=1, div[class*=EndOfFeedPrompt_inlineContainer]=1 ('Get the full app experience'), [data-testid=content-tile] div[class*=CountCard_card]=24 for 12 tiles, div[class*=Footer_entertainmentBar]=1. /discover (Stories) and /topic show the same CTA header, sheet and tab bar. Class-substring anchors (`downloadButton`, `mobileSlides`, `__count`, `CountCard_card`, `EndOfFeedPrompt_inlineContainer`, `Footer_entertainmentBar`) match the stable CSS-module name before the hashed suffix; Snapchat rebuilds could rename them. Fixtures are hand-distilled from these pages. Left alone: video player, tile grid, profile Add button, search, hamburger menu, login on desktop nav. NOT verified: logged-in app; desktop layout (desktop nav Download/Snapchat Ads buttons, desktop footer visibility); Stories player pages beyond landing; /@snapchat showed 'content not found' so the official profile was not seen; the Spotlight page never showed a sign-in wall or timed pop-up in 30 s. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA, logged out, live in the app, 2026-11-10): www.snapchat.com/ serves data-testid=desktop-nav and home-desktop beside the mobile ones; the footer, explore and mobile-nav rules still match. Matched: home-desktop-slides and home-parents. The Open Snapchat links that carry click.snapchat.com are in the mobile nav only.
